about_the_game:
Features present in the Prologue:

  • First part of the story - the Prologue

  • First level

  • Two Bosses

  • Tier 1 Equipment (persistent powerups)

  • About a quarter of the final blessings (ephemeral powerups)

  • Skullball mini game

New features in the ful﻿l game:

  • Full story

  • Four more Levels

  • Three additional equipment tiers

  • more mini games

  • more enemies

  • more bosses

  • more blessings

Blaze a trail through the abyss of an ancient temple where the battle between good and evil has been waged since the dawn of time. Felbound is an action-orientated, roguelike game that combines dungeon crawling with RPG-like progression. Slay enemies, collect materials, craft, die and begin again. Gather persistent weapons, spells, potions, and ephemeral blessings to support you on your journey. Rescue precious friends and challenge dangerous bosses while avoiding their deadly traps.

Discover hidden chambers full of potions, artifacts and clues to unlock the secrets of the temple. But tread carefully, for danger also lurks around every corner.

Rescue potential friends from the clutches of the shadows. Some will help you on your long and arduous journey by providing you with insight, and powerful equipment.

Get sanctified for a small donation and, with the right combination of gear, spells, and potions, become the unstoppable god of destruction yourself, only to lose most of that power if you make the wrong step.

In the temple’s abyss, you will encounter a variety of deadly bosses who have only one goal: your utter destruction! They will put your skills to the test, so equip yourself wisely, and plan your strategy, lest ye be crushed into oblivion!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E6320 (2*1866) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 7600 GS (512 MB) or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Felbound is an action roguelike with a healthy dose of RPG. Explore the abyss of an ancient temple and fight the shadows, using a combination of weapons, spells, and ephemeral blessings. Uncover a myriad of secrets, save friends, and become a powerful god of destruction!
